text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel to have run on the grand 
stage!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It was packed with nothing but the best, 
so it was the absolute most fun ever!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
choice_data_list:
You looked like you were having more fun 
than ever before.

You looked like you were having more fun 
than ever before, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
choice_data_list:
You looked like you were having more fun 
than ever before.

You looked like you were having more fun 
than ever before, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, partly because of running alongside 
such an incredible lineup, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, I really felt like I tapped 
into 'a way of running everyone wants to 
chase'♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Next year... No, far into the future, I 
feel like I'll always enjoy running!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, after the final race of the year 
comes the year's grand finale drive!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's pour all that leftover energy into a 
drive!

The Arima Kinen that I took on with 
Maruzensky concluded after a deeply 
fulfilling run.
